outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrographs (time-lapse images), not a plot of averaged data.

Panel B shows line/scatter plots of normalized intensity over time; the individual measured data points (red/green dots) are plotted directly with fitted model curves overlaid, and insets also show individual points with error bars. As a line/scatter-type plot displaying raw data points rather than a bar chart of summary statistics, it is exempt from requiring additional overlay of individual points, and indeed individual points are already visible.
